title: Scalar tensor natural isomorphism on good representatives
statement: The localized scalarTensorChain components on pairs of good complexes form a natural isomorphism between scalar extension of the source tensor representative functor and the target tensor representative functor applied to scalar-extended good complexes. Its hom component is exactly Q.map scalarTensorChain.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941; categories.tex, Tag 04VK (fully faithful localization descent).

proof.text: For existence, assemble NatIso.ofComponents of asIso of the fixed Q.map scalarTensorChain components. The lower quasi-isomorphism theorem supplies invertibility, and the proved chain naturality supplies naturality after Q. The hom equation is reflexivity. For arbitrary two isomorphisms satisfying this hom-component formula, Iso.ext and NatTrans.ext reduce equality to the component equations; transitivity proves it. Apply existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique to combine the independent existence and uniqueness proofs.
